set.excerpt: Bachelor of Science (BSc): AED 2,500 per credit hour. Estimated Cost Per Year: Bachelor of Science (BSc) 81,250 AED, 4 Years. Housing Fees: Undergraduate Student, Double Occupancy in Double Room AED 10,000 Fall Term, AED 10,000 Spring Term, AED 4,000 Summer Term; Single Occupancy in Double Room AED 20,000 / 20,000 / 8,000. Bachelor of Science (BSc) 81,250 AED 4 Years

UAE General Secondary School and Applied Technology: Mathematics mandatory, along with one science subject (Physics, Biology, or Chemistry); minimum score of 80% for the Advanced and Elite streams, or 90% for the General stream, in the above-mentioned subjects. American High School Diploma, SABIS, Indian (CBSE) and Pakistani Boards: Mathematics mandatory, along with one science subject; minimum of 80% in the final grade (Grade 12) in the above-mentioned subjects. British (IGCSE, GCSE, GCE): a total of 8 subjects; minimum five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with grade C or above; 3 AS Level or 3 A Level subjects (or a combination, minimum 3) may be considered; Mathematics (Mandatory) (minimum Grade C); two of Physics, Chemistry, and/or Biology (minimum Grade C). IB: full IB Diploma with six HL/SL subjects; minimum score of 4 in each subject, total of 24 points; Mathematics mandatory along with one science subject. Mandatory English: IELTS Academic 6.0 OR TOEFL iBT 79. Preferable (strengthens application): Math SAT 700; AP Calculus/Physics C/Chemistry/Biology 3. Program table: Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering etc. X X; Computer Science* O O O (one of the science subjects). Shortlisted applicants will be required to take KU Admission Tests (KUAT). Admission is competitive; meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee final admission. … Undergraduate Admissions for Fall 2027 are now open. Applications will be accepted until 1 February 2027. … Stay tuned for the Fall 2027 application timeline. *Applicants must be awarded the full IB Diploma with six HL/SL subjects (excluding Islamic Education) *Minimum score of 4 in each subject – with a total of 24 points. Minimum five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with grade C or above. Mathematics (Mandatory) (minimum Grade C) • Two of the following: Physics, Chemistry, and/or Biology (minimum Grade C) Mandatory English Proficiency Test Score IELTS Academic 6.0 OR TOEFL iBT 79 Applicants must have graduated from high school no later than two years before the current year (i.e., not before 2023).
